nom: Aveeno Positively Radiant Skin Brightening Daily Facial Scrub with Moisture-Rich Soy Extract

avis.titre: My everyday face scrub!My everyday face scrub!
avis.texte: This is my every day, twice a day face scrub! Definitely gentle enough to use twice a day, morning and evening. Gently scrubs and truly brightens your skin. This face scrub comes to a a nice lather, you only need a small amount.

avis.titre: My Daily Glow Staple that Truly Transformed My Skin
avis.texte: This Aveeno facial scrub has become a true staple in both my morning and evening skincare routine. When I turned 35, I started paying more attention to my overall skin and body care. Without much research, I began using this face wash daily and within just a couple of weeks, I started getting compliments from my mom and sister about how healthy and radiant my skin looked. As a dark-skinned woman, I’ve noticed it really helps even out my complexion and enhance my natural glow. I don’t have particularly sensitive, oily, or dry skin, but this scrub still gave my skin a noticeable boost. What I love most is how refreshed my face feels after using it. It’s not just cleansing, it genuinely feels like a small self-care experience every time I use it. Definitely 100/10 recommend!

avis.titre: Gentle exfoliant for daily use even after 25 years of use
avis.texte: You can't buy a better product for your face. I started using this 25 years ago when my favorite face wash from Benefit stopped making it. Aveeno isn't like that. They understand their customer. As I've gotten older I use it in the shower on my neck & upper chest area. It keeps the skin soft & I haven't gotten that crinkled look most women get in that area. It's very gentle on your skin and is a terrific exfoliate without dying your skin or being to rough. I wouldn't use any other skin care to wash with. Save my money for excellent face cream.

This gentle daily scrub is great! I love the texture, the fragrance and how it gently exfoliates my skin without irritating it. It doesn't strip my skin or dry it out like other exfoliators that I've tried. It's so gentle yet gives a deep cleansing. Even though the fragrance is nice, it does contain fragrance, that's why I gave it only four stars. Overall, it's a great daily exfoliating cleanser that's gentle and works!

avis.titre: Good for sensitive skin but nice gentle exfoliation
avis.texte: My fave face wash. It’s exfoliating but in such a nice gentle way. It doesn’t dry you out but makes it feel like it’s doing something without being abrasive. Good for sensitive skin like mine. I’ve bought it multiple times in a row with no issues!

Nice amount, does the work and leaves your skin feeling renewed and clean, perfect for skin prep prior to makeup. It's kinda watery tho, so if you’re looking for that sand-rubbing feeling then this stuff is not for you.

My favorite face wash. I like the exfoliating. They granuals are gentle and help make me feel like I am getting a more thorough clean, removing any dead skin. Nice deep clean with light scent and no residue.
I use this daily. It works great. I’ve been using this for many years now and it’s never let me down.

avis.titre: Budget friendly but WORTH IT facial cleanser!
avis.texte: Absolutely one of my favorite go to facial cleansers! I’ve been purchasing this for a few years now. It’s gently on my skin, I never break out extra because of it. My face is always left feeling clean and smooth. Totally recommend!

avis.titre: My favorite non harsh face scrub
avis.texte: This size of the product is great for the price and lasts for a while since you dont need much per use. The exfoliating scrub part is not too harsh but just enough to feel the effects.

This Aveeno Scrub cleanse and brightens up my skin very well. It lathers up really good. After use my skin always look like it has a beautiful glow to it. It leaves my skin soft, smooth, and moisturized without it feeling dry. It has a very pleasant scent which smells refreshing. I use it every other day because it can be used daily. I'm glad it's for sensitive skin, so it doesn't causes any irritations on my skin.

avis.titre: Defective bottle cap leaking out cream
avis.texte: Two of the five tubes have damaged bottle caps that lead to leaking cream. The first picture is the defective item and the second one is perfect top.

avis.titre: Obvious product had been opened and returned.
avis.texte: Facial scrubs must be treated like cosmetics. They cannot be opened and then resold. I would never put anything on my face that could have been contaminated by a person who could possibly have whatever skin disease. This should never have been sent out.

avis.titre: Concerned about the authenticity of the product as per how it’s delivered
avis.texte: The product came up scratched on the tube itself from both side which makes me concerned about the authenticity of the product.
Got a used product with absolutely ridiculous packing! Clearly the cap was broken and sealed using a tape!
